C0771.title: IoT Device Misinterpretation of SM Cryptographic Algorithm Compliance
C0771.summary: Some IoT manufacturers port SM4-CBC to MCUs and claim 'national cryptography support,' but overlook critical requirements such as key derivation not using SM3-HMAC, device unique identity not bound to SM2 certificates, and firmware signatures not following GM/T 0015-2012 specifications. While functional, such implementations fail the integrity assessment under GB/T 39786-2021 regarding trusted key
